RIDA1.1.label: Registration or Bulk ID request
RIDA1.1.description: Definition: The customer is asking for Registration IDs, RegIDs, Bulk IDs or remote credentials themselves - to create, add, delete, exchange, extend or renew them, to be told how many remain, or to be told how they work. The IDs are the subject of the request.

RIDA2.label: Not a Registration or Bulk ID request

RIDA2.1.label: Not a Registration or Bulk ID request
RIDA2.1.description: Definition: The customer wants something else. The matched phrase is incidental: an ID quoted as reference, a request for complimentary or trial access that does not specify credentials, a sign-in or entitlement problem that happens to involve an ID the customer already has, or quoted text from an earlier reply.
